# Planyo Online Booking

Planyo is an online reservation system which can be used by any business taking bookings: for days, nights, hours or minutes, or scheduled events.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/planyo-online-booking/.

## Actions

- **Add Reservation**: Create a new reservation.
- **Add User**: Add a new user in Planyo.
- **Get Resource Availability** (read-only): Check resource availability within a specified date/time range.
- **Get Add-on List** (read-only): Retrieve a list of add-ons.
- **Get Coupon List** (read-only): Retrieve a list of coupons.
- **Get Resource Blackouts** (read-only): Fetch blackout periods for a resource.
- **Get Resource Reviews** (read-only): Fetch reviews and ratings for a specific resource.
